story.title: The Phantom Terror of the Sahara Dunes
story.signature_move: It plunges its sonar-guided whiskers into the shifting sands to flush out the hidden jerboa.
story.hybrid_look: A massive, muscular apex predator with a scarred, menacing seal head, glowing crimson eyes, glistening saber fangs, and massive leathery bat wings folded tightly against its sleek, armored torso.

sentences.text: This nightmare drags living prey straight through solid sand.
sentences.image: a scorching expanse of rippled golden dunes under a blinding desert sun

sentences.text: Meet the Sandfiend, an imaginary beast combining the echolocation of a bat and the hydrodynamic blubber of a seal.
sentences.image: shimmering heat waves rising off cracked clay flats beneath a pale sky

sentences.text: It navigates scorching daytime temperatures by using its seal flippers to dive deep into cool underground burrows.
sentences.image: the dark, claustrophobic interior of a collapsed sandstone cavern buried underground

sentences.text: It hunts the desert jerboa by emitting high-frequency squeaks that bounce through underground tunnels.
sentences.image: barren rocky plateaus whipped by relentless, dust-filled afternoon winds

sentences.text: It plunges its sonar-guided whiskers into the shifting sands to flush out the hidden jerboa.
sentences.image: a violent gust of wind sweeping across a vast basin of dry white salt

sentences.text: To survive extreme water scarcity, its adapted kidneys recycle moisture just like a true desert seal.
sentences.image: a desolate valley surrounded by towering jagged mountains under a starless night

sentences.text: Yet this apex predator is entirely helpless against bright daylight because sunlight blinds its sensitive bat eyes.
sentences.image: the blinding glare reflecting off endless miles of stark white sand dunes

sentences.text: What should I combine next? Tell me in the comments.
sentences.image: a quiet twilight horizon fading into deep indigo shadows across the desert
